units.source_text: 多亏我的不幸，使我擅长于洞察人的心理，

en.t: Thanks to my misfortune, I had become skilled at seeing into people's minds,

units.source_text: 她并不是出于怪癖才这样做，

en.t: and she was not doing this out of some eccentric whim,

units.source_text: 我不能简单地在同情中寻找她的爱的动机。

en.t: so I could not simply look for the motive of her love in pity.

units.source_text: 因为我深深地懂得她不会只是出于同情才爱我的。

en.t: For I understood deeply that she would not love me only out of pity.

units.source_text: 根据我的猜测，她爱的原因是出于她那非凡的自尊心。

en.t: As I guessed it, the reason for her love lay in her extraordinary pride.

units.source_text: 她很懂得无比的艳美对于女人的价值，

en.t: She knew very well the value that incomparable beauty has for a woman,

units.source_text: 所以她无法接受很有自信的求爱者。

en.t: and therefore she could not accept a suitor full of confidence.

units.source_text: 她不能把自己的自尊与求爱着的自负放在同一天平上。

en.t: She could not place her own pride and a suitor's self-assurance on the same scales.

units.source_text: 没有什么比所谓良缘使她感到更厌恶的了。

en.t: Nothing disgusted her more than what people call a good match.

units.source_text: 她终于洁迹地拒绝爱情上的所有平衡（在这一点上，她是诚实的）而相中了我。

en.t: In the end, she cleanly rejected every balance in love (on this point, she was honest) and chose me.
